full_prompt_en: The image is a square sepia drawing of a bearded man sitting in a sturdy chair among several human skulls. He is placed slightly left of center, his torso facing forward while one leg crosses over the other. Long hair and a full beard surround a stern, thoughtful face. He wears a jacket over a buttoned vest and trousers. One hand rests on the chair arm at the left, and the other holds or grips the right armrest. Skulls appear on a shelf or table to his right, one high behind his head, and others near the lower corners. Their rounded craniums, dark eye sockets, and teeth are rendered with the same careful linework as the man's face and clothing. Behind the chair, fine sketch lines suggest branches, carved forms, and architectural elements without resolving into a single definite room. The background is an aged tan paper field, not a fully painted space. Dark brown pen or pencil hatching models the jacket folds, beard, wood grain, and skull cavities. Some lines are precise and dense, while others remain loose exploratory marks. The lower area has more white or lightly toned paper showing through, with small gray-blue washlike touches near the base. Illumination is implied by unmarked paper on the face and trousers, contrasted with crosshatched shadows beneath the chair and around the objects. The composition has an informal archival look, as though a detailed study and a symbolic tableau occupy the same page. Its mood is reflective and macabre rather than violent. The drawing's visual character comes from monochrome sepia ink, granular paper texture, irregular sketch edges, and the strange calm of a seated figure amid skulls.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形棕褐色素描，一位有胡须的男子坐在结实的椅子上，周围是数颗人类骷髅。他略偏中央左侧，上身朝前，一条腿搭在另一条腿上。长发和浓须包围一张严厉而沉思的脸。他穿外套、扣着纽扣的背心和长裤。一只手放在左侧扶手，另一只扶住右扶手。骷髅出现在他右边的架或桌上、脑后高处，以及下方角落附近。圆头骨、深眼窝与牙齿由和人脸衣服同样细心的线工刻出。椅后，细素描线暗示枝条、雕刻形和建筑元素，却没有组成单一明确的室内。背景是一片陈旧黄褐纸，而非完整绘制的空间。深褐钢笔或铅笔排线塑造外套衣褶、胡须、木纹与骷髅凹处。有些线准确且密，有些仍是松散的探索笔记。下方露出更多白或淡调纸面，底部附近有少量灰蓝色洗痕。照明由脸和裤子上的未画纸面暗示，与椅下和物件周围的交叉排线阴影对照。构图有非正式档案感，仿佛细致研究与象征画面共处一页。情绪沉思且带死亡意味，却不暴烈。视觉性格来自单色棕褐墨、颗粒纸肌理、不规则素描边和骷髅间端坐人物的奇异平静。
style_prompt_en: Sepia draftsmanship combines dense pen or pencil hatching with open paper and loose exploratory lines. Warm tan ground carries dark brown contours, crosshatched recesses, and occasional faint wash. Figures and objects receive careful anatomical and material detail, while surrounding architecture or foliage may remain partly unresolved. Unmarked paper acts as light; shadow accumulates through repeated directional marks instead of smooth tone. The edges can fade into sketches, stains, and small marks, retaining an archival handmade quality. The result is reflective, textured, and slightly macabre, balancing formal central weight with informal drawing process.
style_prompt_zh: 棕褐色素描技法把密集钢笔或铅笔排线与开放纸面、松散探索线结合。暖黄褐底承载深褐轮廓、交叉排线凹处与偶尔淡色洗痕。人物与物体有仔细的解剖和材料细节，周围建筑或植物则可部分未完成。未画纸面担当光，阴影靠重复方向笔痕积累，而非平滑调子。边缘可淡入草稿、污渍和小笔记，保留档案般手工品质。效果沉思、有肌理且略带死亡意味，在正式中央重量与非正式绘制过程之间平衡。
theme_en: A seated bearded man surrounded by skulls in a sepia sketch
theme_zh: 一位坐着的长须男子在棕褐色素描中被骷髅围住
name: Alan Moore
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
